revision: S1 placement (THT only + the vertical USB-C and the board-to-board headers). 6HP, two boards: carrier (jack/pot board, 4 layers) and MCU board (4 layers) stacked on the carrier F side on 2.54 mm pin headers. Every other SMD part parked off-board for group-by-group placement. Not routed.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY, for the carrier, the MCU board and the panel. The carrier F side faces the panel; the MCU board sits on the carrier F side with its own F side facing the panel, so both KiCad top views equal the front view (no mirroring).

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm carrier as modules/32bit. Held by the four jack nuts; the MCU board hangs on it.

mcu_pcb.note: 29.0 x 29.55 mm (R1: 2.55 mm longer than S1 so U101 fits below U102 and the USB-C). 4 layers for the USB 2.0 HS pair (90 ohm differential over In1 GND). All SMD on F (one assembly side), facing the panel.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear (as modules/8bit/32bit).
stack_Z_mm.usbc_note: USB-C needs its mouth no more than ~0.3 mm behind the panel front or the plug cannot seat (receptacle depth 6.20 mm vs plug shell 6.51-6.65 mm). HRO TYPE-C-31-D-15 (8.8 mm) on a 1.6 mm MCU board on 2.5 mm header plastic puts it 1.3 mm proud; the same land takes D-15A..D (9.3/10/10.5/12.4 mm). A 1.0 mm MCU board would make it 0.7 mm proud.

layout_note: User brief 2026-10-23: inputs = socket then pot (left to right), outputs = pot then socket. Columns X8.0 / X22.0 keep the RV09 courtyards >= 1.0 mm from the carrier edge (1.55 / 1.05 mm). Rows IN1 Y46, IN2 Y62, OUT1 Y79, OUT2 Y95 (16-17 mm pitch, 1 mm between courtyards in a row pair). The MCU board takes the top band (Y10-37) with the USB-C at X15 Y16.

usb_slot.note: Obround NPTH slot for the receptacle shell (8.94 x 3.16 mm) with ~0.27 mm clearance a side; the shell passes through and stands 1.3 mm proud.

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power, bottom centre (as modules/32bit). THT, B side
SWD (WCH-LinkE): pin 1 +3V3 at the top, B side, beside J1
